external_deps: Claude Code or another supported agent host

review.tagline: Skill-based research workflow for Claude Code with cross-model review
review.summary: ARIS is a set of 82 skills that run an autonomous research workflow (idea discovery, experiments, paper writing) inside Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor and similar agents. An executor model drives the work while an independent reviewer, Codex through an MCP bridge over `codex exec` by default, critiques it. It also ships as a Claude Code and Codex plugin and as a standalone Rust CLI, ARIS-Code.
review.audience: Researchers using Claude Code or Codex to automate experiments and paper writing
strengths: Works across Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Trae, Copilot CLI and OpenClaw
Separate reviewer model checks the executor's output; alternative model combinations are documented
Ships as plain skills, plugins, or a standalone CLI with prebuilt releases
MIT licensed, with frequent releases (ARIS-Code v0.4.28 on 2026-09-28)
weaknesses: Default reviewer depends on codex-cli; its MCP entry point was removed in 0.154
Aimed at research and paper workflows, not general application coding
Large surface (82 skills, many helpers) and a changelog-heavy README
Per-host adaptations live in separate docs, so support varies by agent
needs: Needs Claude Code or another supported agent host, codex-cli (default reviewer), Python
Models: Claude Opus 5, Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-6-Astra, ModelScope-hosted models, DeepSeek
